- [Automation & Chatbots](https://www.surgex.pt/en/services/automation): Intelligent chatbots, automated follow-ups, email sequences, process automation — from 25€/month
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.surgex.pt/en/services/marketing): Google Ads, social media management, content creation, lead generation — all AI-powered

- [Training & Workshops](https://www.surgex.pt/en/services/training): Hands-on AI training for teams, prompt engineering, tool selection, workflow integration
